# Snap Before/Snap After

When importing meter or source analysis data, some records will not come in at the top of an hour. This can cause missing data exceptions and it may appear that you have duplicate records with one hour missing and another with data.

In the meter imported below, data appears to be missing for every other hour. In this case, the data is coming in one second before the hour (ex. 16:59:59 instead of 17:00:00).



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 656;height: 258;" />

To fix this issue, go to **Setup** \> **Meter** \> **Meter Editor** and adjust the Snap Before and Snap After option on the **Imports** tab. Enter the number of seconds before and/or after the time frame you are trying to adjust. Usually putting 10 to 15 seconds in the Snap Before and the Snap After fields resolves most of these data cases.

To resolve the issue:

1.  Go to **Setup** \> **Meter** \> **Meter Editor** \>**Imports** tab.
2.  Click **Edit**.
3.  Enter the number of seconds before and after the hour you want to adjust. It is best to enter a value in both fields to catch both scenarios.
4.  Click **Save**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 538;height: 449;" />

Once saved, any data that is imported going forward will be adjusted if the records do not start at the top of the hour.

If you set this option after importing data, you will need to purge the existing data and re-import it to reflect the changes.

To purge the data:

1.  Go to **Tools** \> **Purge** \> **Meter Data**.
2.  Select the meter and then specify the correct contract month or date range where records do not come in at the top of the hour.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 469;height: 187;" />

Once the data is purged, re-import the data by going to Import \> Meter Data.

The following example shows how this option corrected the data.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 743;height: 176;" />

The Snap Before and Snap After option is also available for source analyses within the [Source Analysis Editor](../../Source%20Analysis/Gas%20Quality%20Source%20Editor/Main%20Tab.md). This option is used most often when collecting gas quality data from a gas chromatograph when the data is not coming in at the top of the hour. To set this option for source analyses, go to Setup \> Source Analysis \> Gas Quality \> Main tab.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 593;height: 497;" />
